extracted.name: Chicken Tostadas
extracted.description: Turn a regular rotisserie chicken until this yummy meal using a few ingredients
ingredient_lines: Chipotle in adobo sauce or chipotle powder
Olive oil for sautéing and frying
instruction_lines: Add olive oil to pan over medium heat. Add chicken and seasoned with chili powder salt and pepper all purpose seasoning. Add onion and garlic powder. Sauté an additional minute then remove from heat.
Add olive oil to coat bottom of pan. Add corn tortillas. Flip tortillas and season fried side with chili powder. Flip again and season the other side with chili powder.
Once tortillas are crispy add chicken to the top. Add mixed cheese. Remove when cheese is melted. You can add a few splashes of water to pan and cover with lid to melt cheese faster.
Combine avocado tomato onion jalapeño and cilantro. Add salt pepper and lime juice and mash thoroughly to create your guacamole.
Mix one tablespoon of adobo sauce or 1 teaspoon of chipotle powder to sour cream.
Top tostadas with guacamole, spinach, chipotle cream and garnish with Cojita cheese.
